user.title: Add a Kiosk Satellite device
user.description:
Enter the device's IP address and ADB port. When you click Submit, an "Allow USB debugging?" dialog will appear on the device screen (especially on new or factory-reset devices) — please check "Always allow" and tap Allow on the device screen.

The wizard will wait for you to allow access before continuing.

device_info.title: Configure Kiosk Satellite device
device_info.description:
Detected: {device_model}. Pre-filled from the device's own Android device name -- override if you'd like. The password is set as Kiosk Satellite's own admin password once it's installed, and used to connect it to this Home Assistant instance automatically.

Note: If "Set Kiosk Satellite as Home Launcher" is enabled, Android requires you to select Kiosk Satellite as the default home app on the device screen when prompted.

existing_device_info.description: Kiosk Satellite is already installed, so its Home Launcher and Home Assistant token settings will be left unchanged. Enter its existing Web UI password so Kiosk Satellite Manager can connect to port 2324 when needed.
